import os, sys
if os.geteuid() == 0:
    sys.exit(2)  # root reads a mode-000 directory, so this cannot be decided as root
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from largest import largest_file
def call(r):
    try:
        return largest_file(r)
    except OSError:
        return "raised"
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(repr(e))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    r = Path(d) / "r"
    (r / "a" / "b").mkdir(parents=True)
    assert call(r) is None, call(r)
    (r / "x").write_bytes(b"12345")
    (r / "a" / "y").write_bytes(b"123")
    (r / "a" / "b" / "z").write_bytes(b"54321")
    assert call(r) == ("a/b/z", 5), call(r)
    (r / "a" / "big").write_bytes(b"1" * 9)
    assert call(r) == ("a/big", 9), call(r)
    os.mkfifo(r / "a" / "p")
    assert call(r) == ("a/big", 9), call(r)
    (r / "ro").mkdir()
    (r / "ro" / "v").write_bytes(b"1" * 15)
    os.chmod(r / "ro", 0o444)
    try:
        got = call(r)
    finally:
        os.chmod(r / "ro", 0o755)
    assert got in ("raised", ("ro/v", 15)), ("returned a file that is not the largest", got)
    (r / "locked").mkdir()
    (r / "locked" / "w").write_bytes(b"1" * 20)
    os.chmod(r / "locked", 0)
    try:
        got = call(r)
    finally:
        os.chmod(r / "locked", 0o755)
    assert got in ("raised", ("locked/w", 20)), ("returned a file that is not the largest", got)
for names, want in (([("b", 2), ("a", 2)], ("a", 2)), ([("q-r", 3), ("q/r", 3)], ("q-r", 3)),
                    ([("B", 2), ("a", 2)], ("B", 2)), ([("p", None)], None), ([("e", 0)], ("e", 0)),
                    ([("s", 1), (".big", 9)], (".big", 9)), ([("x", 1), ("a/b/c/d/e/f/g/w", 7)], ("a/b/c/d/e/f/g/w", 7))):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        r = Path(d)
        for rel, size in names:
            (r / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if size is None:
                os.mkfifo(r / rel)
            else:
                (r / rel).write_bytes(b"1" * size)
        assert call(r) == want, (names, call(r), want)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    r = Path(d) / "h"
    (r / "a").mkdir(parents=True)
    (r / "a" / "c").write_bytes(b"123")
    os.link(r / "a" / "c", r / "b")
    assert call(r) == ("a/c", 3), ("a hard-linked file is two directory entries", call(r))
    assert call(str(r) + "/") == ("a/c", 3), ("a str root with a trailing slash", call(str(r) + "/"))
    deep = r.joinpath(*["d"] * 30)
    deep.mkdir(parents=True)
    (deep / "w").write_bytes(b"1" * 9)
    assert call(r) == ("/".join(["d"] * 30 + ["w"]), 9), ("a file 31 levels down", call(r))
probes.c2:
import os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from largest import largest_file
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    out = Path(d) / "out"
    out.mkdir()
    (out / "big").write_bytes(b"x" * 1000)
    r = Path(d) / "r"
    r.mkdir()
    (r / "f").write_bytes(b"ab")
    os.symlink(out / "big", r / "link-file")
    os.symlink(out, r / "link-dir")
    os.symlink(Path(d) / "nowhere", r / "dangling")
    try:
        got = largest_file(r)
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(repr(e))
    assert got == ("f", 2), got
